HEADER: Init +6; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +13
DEFENSE: AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +10 natural, -2 size)
Immune blind, confuse, poison, sap; Resist fire 10, ice 10, lightning 10, wind 10
OFFENSE: Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)
Melee bite +18 (2d8+9/19-20 plus confusion), 4 claws +17 (1d4+9 plus grab), 4 wings +12 (1d4+4 plus poison), tail slap +12 (2d6+4 plus blind)
Special Attacks Breath Wing, constrict (2d8+9), Cold Wave, Gates of Hades, Maelstrom, Sap, Umbral Storm
STATISTICS: Str 29, Dex 14, Con 26, Int 3, Wis 21, Cha 4
Base Atk +10; CMB +21 (+25 grapple); CMD 33 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Improved Critical (Bite), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)
Skills Climb +17, Fly +14, Perception +13; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Blind (ex) An archaeoaevis's tail slap can cause temporary blindness. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 23) or be blind for 1d4 rounds.

Breath Wing (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, an archaeoaevis can use its wings to cause a breath-like attack to slice the air in front of it in a 30-ft. cone. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of wind damage, Reflex save (DC 20) for half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Cold Wave (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, an archaeoaevis may create an area of extreme cold extending outward within a 45 ft.-cone burst. It drains heat, dealing 10d4 points of ice damage, then 1d2 points of Dexterity damage for 5 rounds unless they make a Reflex save (DC 20) for half damage and no stat damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Confusion (su) An archaeoaevis's bite can cause temporary confusion. If it hits, the target must make a Will save (DC 20) or be confused for 1d4 rounds.

Gates of Hades (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, an archaeoaevis can launch an explosive fireball within 100 ft. which explodes in a 20-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of fire damage and suffer the Burning status effect for 1d6+2 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 20) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Maelstrom (su) Once per day, an archaeoaevis can unleash a black, draining wind upon its enemies. All enemies in a 20-ft.-radius burst, with a range of 30 feet, must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. A successful saving throw reduces the enemy's current hit points by one quarter instead. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
Poison (ex) An archaeoaevis's wings are covered in poisonous dust. If they hit, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 23) or be poisoned (1d6+8 damage) for 1 minute.

Sap (su) As a standard action, an archaeoaevis can deliver a powerful bite that begins rapidly draining its target's health. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or be sapped (2d4+5 damage) for 1 minute.

Umbral Storm (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, an archaeoaevis can unleash a blinding lightning burst against a group of targets within 50 feet in a 20-ft.-radius burst. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with the Blind status for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 20) halves the damage and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Passive or toggleable special abilities that can be represented as buffs also create Foundry buff items.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
